== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Harinfel was once a small village located in [[Lysander Torannus|Lysander]]'s realm, situated southeast of the [[Latari Forest]]. The settlement was effectively destroyed by the [[Valinhall Incarnation|Incarnation of Valinhall]], who arrived at dawn and engaged in a series of duels with the [[inhabitants]]. During this violent event, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] killed most people encountered, including those attempting to flee, though he spared individuals who fought well or those he deemed unworthy of his attention, such as the elderly and children. Consequently, the village was reduced to a [[graveyard]], with approximately eighty percent of its population lost. The site now exists as empty remnants overlooking an open field on a high hill, located northwest of the village of [[Belcor]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Situated on a high hill southeast of the [[Latari Forest]] within [[Lysander Torannus|Lysander]]'s realm, Harinfel was once a populated settlement. The village eventually fell into ruin, leaving behind only empty remnants after [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] destroyed it. This devastation resulted in the loss of nearly eighty percent of its residents. During their journey, a group traveled toward the location, eventually establishing a camp just outside the former village site.}}
